تسامعت (form VI)

# تَسَامَعْتَ (tasāmaʕta) /ta.saː.maʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَامَعَ (tasāmaʕa)
# تَسَامَعْتِ (tasāmaʕti) /ta.saː.maʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَامَعَ (tasāmaʕa)
# تَسَامَعَتْ (tasāmaʕat) /ta.saː.ma.ʕat/: third-person fem
